allusions.quote: Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not; for she that is desolate hath many more children than she that hath an husband.
If Noah, Job, and Daniel should rise up, they should not deliver their children in captivity.
Their worm shall not die, and their fire shall not be quenched, and they shall be a spectacle to all flesh.
Continually My name is blasphemed among all the Gentiles,
